paper_title: SpecMemo: Speculative Decoding is in Your Pocket
societal_problem: The inability to efficiently deploy large language models (LLMs) on memory-constrained devices, such as mobile GPUs or small server GPUs, limits access to advanced AI applications in resource-constrained environments, hindering democratized AI adoption.
solution_architecture: The solution involves developing a device-aware inference engine, SpecMemo, which uses speculative decoding optimized for memory-constrained devices. The architecture includes a backend for memory-efficient speculative decoding, a distributed processing layer for multi-GPU setups, and a frontend API for seamless integration. The tech stack includes Python, PyTorch for LLM inference, CUDA for GPU optimization, FastAPI for API development, Docker for containerization, and Kubernetes for multi-GPU orchestration.

tasks.description: Set up the project repository with basic configurations, including Python environment, dependencies, and Dockerfile for containerization.
Implement the core memory modeling algorithm to calculate the lower bound of memory allocation required for speculative decoding.
Develop the speculative decoding logic to generate candidate tokens and manage acceptance/rejection efficiently.
Implement memory management features to minimize redundant memory allocations for rejected candidate tokens.
Design and implement a distributed processing layer to enable batched speculative decoding across multiple GPUs.
Integrate Llama-2-70B-Chat model and optimize it for distributed speculative decoding on small server GPUs.
Develop an API using FastAPI to expose SpecMemo's capabilities for multi-turn chatbot applications.
Implement unit tests for the memory modeling algorithm and speculative decoding logic.
Set up CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, building, and deployment of the application.
Develop a monitoring and logging system to track memory usage, throughput, and error rates during inference.
Optimize CUDA kernels for GPU memory management and speculative decoding performance.
Conduct performance benchmarking to validate memory savings, throughput improvements, and speedup gains on various GPU configurations.
Write comprehensive documentation for developers and users, including API usage, deployment instructions, and troubleshooting guides.
Containerize the application using Docker and deploy it on a Kubernetes cluster for multi-GPU orchestration.
Prepare a demo application showcasing SpecMemo's multi-turn chatbot capabilities on memory-constrained devices.
